scope.path_rule: request path equals /api/source or starts with /api/source/
scope.out_of_scope_router: existing router and existing route-specific validation; this twelve-gate pipeline does not run

transport_validation.pipeline_rule: Run gates in ascending order and stop at the first failure. No route, source, draft, review, contract, confirmation, freeze, evidence, replay, or timing state may mutate before all twelve gates pass.
transport_validation.combined_failure_precedence: The lowest numeric gate order wins across every pair or larger combination of faults; within one gate, fault_precedence wins.

ordered_pipeline.stream_read_oracle: Read at most 65,537 bytes. Exactly 65,536 bytes is allowed only when it equals the canonical Content-Length. Byte 65,537 always returns source_request_too_large before JSON parsing.

duplicate_member_semantics.scope: every JSON object at every nesting depth, including objects nested inside arrays
duplicate_member_semantics.comparison: exact decoded Unicode member-name sequence after JSON escape decoding; no normalization or case folding
duplicate_member_semantics.detection_order: parser document order; the first duplicate encountered terminates gate 9
duplicate_member_semantics.error_disclosure: return only duplicate_json_member; never echo the member name or value

validation_algorithm: after the empty-body check, decode the complete body as strict UTF-8; any decoding failure returns malformed_json
parse the complete document into a member-pair-preserving representation; any syntax or trailing-data failure returns malformed_json even when a duplicate member occurs earlier in document order
only after complete parse success, walk every object depth-first in parser document order and return duplicate_json_member for the first repeated decoded member name
only after duplicate scanning, require the top-level value to be an object; exact request-field validation remains gate 10

within_gate_precedence_probes.reason: complete-document syntax validation precedes duplicate-member scanning
